description: Source code for the FXAS21002 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including SPI and I2C communication, initialization, and data fetching.

methods.name: fxas21002_transceive
methods.description: Performs SPI transceive operation with the sensor.

methods.name: fxas21002_read_spi
methods.description: Reads data from the sensor via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_read_spi
methods.description: Reads a byte from the sensor via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_write_spi
methods.description: Writes a byte to the sensor via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_reg_field_update_spi
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register via SPI.

methods.name: fxas21002_read_i2c
methods.description: Reads data from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_read_i2c
methods.description: Reads a byte from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_byte_write_i2c
methods.description: Writes a byte to the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_reg_field_update_i2c
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register via I2C.

methods.name: fxas21002_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to sensor_value units.

methods.name: fxas21002_get_power
methods.description: Gets the current power state of the sensor.

methods.name: fxas21002_set_power
methods.description: Sets the power state of the sensor.

methods.name: fxas21002_get_transition_time
methods.description: Calculates transition time between power states.
